title: Before the First Cup
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Don't talk to me before the first cup,
the sun is up but I am not up,
the kettle sings, the beans go round,
the sweetest, darkest morning sound.

[Chorus]
Before the first cup, I'm a zombie in a robe,
before the first cup, I don't love anyone I know,
then it hits me warm and slow,
and I'm ready, here I go.

[Verse 2]
My cat knows better than to meow,
my phone stays face down until now,
one sip, two sips, the world comes back,
the colours slowly leave the black.

[Chorus]
Before the first cup, I'm a zombie in a robe,
before the first cup, I don't love anyone I know,
then it hits me warm and slow,
and I'm ready, here I go.
reason: Chorus lines differ by two or three syllables, normal pop phrasing; funny, on topic, singable.
